title:
SPACOM SERIAL
COMMUNICATION SYSTEM
text:
As Marty McFly was heading back to the future, we were exploring new digital horizons in Vaasa, just with fewer hoverboards involved. That year we launched the SPACOM secondary equipment family that allowed our microprocessor relays to communicate serially with fiber optics.

This marked a big leap from electromechanical logic to software and data-driven protection. SPACOM helped turn power system protection into a coordinated system, basically giving relays their first taste of the digital age.
funFact: The sci-fi genre really boomed in the ‘80s as excitement about new technology and the future was reshaping pop culture. The cult classic Back to the Future was one of that year’s highest-grossing movies.
